record.official_rationale: Purchasing-power and tax grievances; Boulou freight protesters also cited Spanish agricultural imports.

Boulou is an approach toll, not a border-gate coordinate. Police dispersal does not by itself establish resumed traffic. Ventimiglia passenger movement was no longer blocked by noon, while trucks remained blocked. No single whole-border or continuous multi-site interval.
